# Auto-reload

> [!WARNING]
> This mod is deprecated: This mod is deprecated. We will not offer support for this mod and it will not be updated. This mod's functionality is now included in the SWAG image

This mod allows Nginx to be reloaded automatically whenever there are new files, or valid changes to the files in /config/nginx.

Add it to the `swag` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:swag-auto-reload
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:swag-auto-reload|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## DEPRECATION NOTICE

### This mod is deprecated. We will not offer support for this mod and it will not be updated. This mod's functionality is now included in the SWAG image

If you'd like for Nginx to be reloaded when other files or folders are modified (not included in our default list above), set a new environment variable, `WATCHLIST`, and set it to a list of container relative paths separated by `|` like the below example:

`WATCHLIST="/config/nginx/custom.conf|/config/nginx/customfolder"`

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/swag-auto-reload/
